title: Counterbalanced ordinary-chat and Hindsight memory PLAIN/HADES comparison
classification: synthetic local comparative benchmark; no owner preference or release qualification

method.counterbalance: Alternating PLAIN-first and HADES-first; requests serialized; each gateway has one warmup before samples.
method.data: Synthetic favorite-fruit preference only. Five repeated saves/corrections in one profile per stack test current-value recall as old assertions accumulate. Temporary homes, container and database volume.
method.privacy: Ollama endpoint restricted to loopback; Docker bridge forwarder bound only to bridge gateway; Ollama server launched with OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1.

limitations: The model digest is staged local Qwen; this does not prove equality with production model weights.
Gateway stack order is balanced, but each task sequence is serialized and no human quality ratings were collected.
A fresh recall is a new Hermes session in the same private profile/subject. This does not qualify Open WebUI authentication, household UI isolation, or populated production data migration.
Provider metrics are aggregate structural/timing data. Naturalness and whether Scotty prefers either workflow require direct owner review.

HADES Hindsight background retain/retrieval work and PLAIN model generations shared the same local Ollama instance. This introduced cross-arm resource interference; ordinary-chat timings, and some within-turn latencies, are diagnostic rather than clean isolated stack comparisons.

interpretation.ordinary_chat: Medians: PLAIN 1.27 s TTFT / 1.63 s total; HADES 1.27 s / 1.67 s. Several individual turns rose to 6–8 s while Hindsight background work shared the Ollama endpoint. Treat this as a resource-contention warning, not a stable ordinary-chat delta.
interpretation.automatic_cross_session_recall: PLAIN correct 5/5 at 1.49 s median. HADES correct 4/5 at 3.46 s median; the one miss preceded Hindsight visibility in the post-answer list. The other four facts were visible after answer. Subject isolation was exercised only synthetically.
interpretation.explicit_save_correction: HADES route median was 5.82 s for save and 5.50 s for correction, both with zero model generations; PLAIN medians were 3.13 s and 2.17 s, each using two generations and a memory tool. The benchmark did not measure when Hindsight made each corrected value durable.
interpretation.preference: UNASSIGNED; no owner ratings, natural conversation corpus, UI, or production behavior were included.

source_revision_note: The paired run used committed source base 45bc95dc with the uncommitted runner update that accepts an isolated Hermes install prefix, identifies its version, and selects bundled-vs-external Hindsight provider layout.
